title: Store migrations
what: The store's shape as ordered migrations with their way up and down, run before anything is served, and recorded so a store opened by a newer service is brought up to it.

title: Store snapshot
what: A consistent copy of the store with a manifest beside it, taken by snapshot and held to its manifest by verify, for a deployment's backup before anything changes.

title: The store
what: The one SQLite file keeping consumers, groups, subjects, targets and their records, the attempt log, the event window and the round, every write handed a time by its caller.
